name: Shahlon Silk Industries Limite
summary: Shahlon Silk Industries Ltd. specializes in the production of synthetic textile yarns and unfinished fabrics. Their extensive fabric range includes solid-dyed, jacquard, yarn-dyed, printed, and eco-friendly options, as well as greige materials. These versatile textiles are suitable for numerous applications such as weaving, furnishing, making laces and tapes, knitting, velvet production, and labels. Founded in 1984, the company is based in Surat, India.
